kirchbruecke.name: Matterhorn
kirchbruecke.slogan: One pyramid of rock that turns Zermatt into a postcard at dawn.
kirchbruecke.line: Hurrah! again; not a footstep could be seen.
kirchbruecke.by: Edward Whymper, Scrambles Amongst the Alps, 1871, on the first ascent

gornergratkulm.name: Gornergrat
gornergratkulm.slogan: A cog railway to a ridge ringed by 4000-metre giants.
gornergratkulm.line: The Gornergrat railway opened in 1898 and climbs almost 1,500 metres from Zermatt, Europe's highest open-air railway.

valerecastle.name: Valère Castle
valerecastle.slogan: A fortified church crowning its own hill above Sion.
valerecastle.line: Its pipe organ, believed to date from 1435, is among the oldest still playable in the world.

eggishorn.name: Eggishorn & Aletsch Glacier
eggishorn.slogan: A river of ice, 23 km long, flowing below your boots.
eggishorn.line: The Aletsch Glacier, the largest in the Alps, has ice more than 900 metres thick and became UNESCO World Heritage in 2001.

saintmauriceabbey.name: Abbey of Saint-Maurice
saintmauriceabbey.slogan: Fifteen centuries of prayer beside a gorge in the Rhône.
saintmauriceabbey.line: The monastery was founded in 515 by King Sigismund of Burgundy, over the shrine of St Maurice and the Theban Legion.
